weekly.title: What changed
weekly.intro_one: Your program for the week, at its new loads. 1 lift changed — tap it to see what I saw.
weekly.intro_other: Your program for the week, at its new loads. {{count}} lifts changed — tap any of them to see what I saw.
weekly.steady: Everything held steady this week — keep showing up and the work compounds.

consent.title: Before we start.
consent.body: Hush coaches you with data you log here. I keep it to run your training and improve how I coach. You can export or delete it anytime.

connectHealth.title: Connect Health
connectHealth.body: Hush reads your heart rate, calories and distance during the runs and walks you record — so the effort is real, not estimated. You'll answer a few quick things next either way.
connectHealth.optional: Optional. You can change this anytime.

experience.beginnerDesc: New to lifting, or just starting out.
experience.intermediateDesc: Training consistently, comfortable with the basics.
experience.advancedDesc: Experienced, with strong lifts across the board.

home.restSub: Every session this week is done. Recovery is part of the program — nothing to do today.
home.hubThisWeekSub: The full week, workout by workout
home.restNext: Your next week opens Sunday morning

cardio.title: Run or walk
cardio.introPre: Hush coaches your lifts. Your runs, it simply
cardio.introPost: — no targets, no grading. The effort is yours.
cardio.goalOpenNote: No goal. Move as long as you like — Hush keeps the log either way.
cardio.savedNote: Saved to your log. Hush doesn't grade your runs and your lifting program is untouched — this is yours to keep.
cardio.gpsOff: No location access — recording time only

ob.signinTagline: A strength coach that owns the decisions, so you can own the work.
ob.signinLegal: By continuing you agree to begin setup. You can stop at any time.
ob.consentSub: Hush makes training decisions on your behalf. To do that responsibly, it needs your agreement on how your data is used.
ob.consentCard: Your training data is yours. It is used only to make your recommendations. It is never sold.
ob.nameSub: Used only to address you. Leave it blank to stay anonymous.
ob.healthSub: Hush reads heart rate, calories and distance for the runs and walks you record. Optional, and you can change it later.
ob.bodySub: Hush needs these to calibrate starting loads. Numbers only — nothing public.
ob.trainSub: Experience calibrates your starting loads. Frequency shapes the split — no wasted days, no overreach.
ob.expBeginnerDesc: New to structured lifting — Hush starts conservative
ob.expIntermediateDesc: Comfortable with the main lifts and steady progression
ob.expAdvancedDesc: Years of consistent training and refined technique
ob.readyOwnership:
Hush decides the loads.
You decide the lifts.
ob.readyNote: Hush only adds load your last sessions have earned — steady, never guesswork.

calibration.framing: The first few workouts are for me to learn you. Weights start light — that's deliberate.

workout.coachingUp: Up {{delta}} from last week. You're ready for it.
workout.reasonIncrease: Up {{delta}} from last time. You earned it.
workout.reasonDecrease: Down {{delta}} today. Three hard sessions in a row — this is the smart move.
workout.recorded: Recorded. Hush is updating your next recommendation.

finishSheet.body: End this session now? Completed sets are saved. Hush will account for the shortened session in your next recommendation.

reasonSheet.increase: Your last three top sets moved faster than the weight on the bar. That's room to grow.
reasonSheet._comment_holdDecrease: Verbatim sheet sentences for hold/decrease not quoted in spec — reusing the one-line cause (not invented). Pending sign-off (content gap).
reasonSheet.hold: Holding here — your recent sessions read as fatigue, not weakness.
reasonSheet.decrease: Down {{delta}} today. Three hard sessions in a row — this is the smart move.

pauseSheet.title: Workout paused
pauseSheet.body: Your completed sets are saved. Finish now and Hush reads the shortened session into your next recommendation.

whyLoad.learning: This is your first week — Hush is still learning how you train. The loads start deliberate; from next week they adapt to you, and every change shows up here.
whyLoad.lineUp: Your last sessions cleared the top of the range here, so Hush moved the load up {{delta}} {{unit}}.
whyLoad.lineDown: Your recent sets came in under range, so Hush matched the load to what you're lifting clean — and kept every set.
whyLoad.lineHold: Right on target — strong, but Hush held the load until the signal is clean.
whyLoad.note: Hush never moves a load on a single session. It reads the pattern, then acts — your job is just to lift.

complete.bodyEarly: Session saved. Hush will account for the shortened session in your next recommendation.
complete.reading: Hush is reading your session · {{sets}} sets
complete.notStartedBody: No exercises completed. Nothing was saved — start again whenever you're ready.

milestones.firstRaiseSub: Hush moved your load up. Earned, not scheduled.

load.remembered: We'll remember this weight next time

firstGym.title: We're learning your gym
firstGym.body1: Every gym is a little different. During your first few workouts, Hush may occasionally name a weight that isn't on your equipment.
firstGym.body2: If that happens, choose the closest weight available. Hush remembers it and becomes more accurate over time.

portrait.lockedBody: I'm learning how your body moves. {{remaining}} more sessions and I'll show you what I see.
portrait.headline: What your body can do
portrait.insightStrongest: I'm building around your {{pattern}}. It's your strongest.
portrait.compareProof: Your {{capability}} went from your weakest to {{state}}.

swap.title: Swap exercise
swap.body: Equipment busy? Choose an alternative for the same muscle group. Hush keeps your load progression intact.

report.title: Your progress
report.subtitle: Your strongest lifts, then and now.
report.empty: Keep training — your progress will show here.
report.startingPointSub: This is where you begin. Every gain from here is measured against it.

history.title: History
history.summaryMoved: moved across {{weeks}} weeks. Every rep you've done is here.
history.empty: Your first session will appear here.
history.annSwapped: I swapped in {{exercise}} — the rack was taken.

profile.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all data?
profile.trialNote: You're only billed after your seven free sessions — never during. Choose a plan when you're ready.
profile.healthNote: Hush reads heart rate, calories and distance for the runs and walks you record. It never writes to Health, and none of it touches your lifting program.

settings.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all data?

paywall.benefitAdapts: A weekly read on what changed, and why.

progressReps.text: {{ex}} is near the top of its range, so I added a rep per set.
progressReps.observation: {{ex}} is improving and close to the top of its range.
progressReps.conclusion: Another rep per set comes before more weight.
progressReps.action: I set the target to {{reps}} reps.

progressLoad.text: {{ex}} hit the top of its range with room, so I added {{delta}} kg.
progressLoad.textVariation: {{ex}} is holding the top of its range — keep it there and the harder variation comes next.
progressLoad.observation: {{ex}} reached the top of its range with room to spare.
progressLoad.conclusion: It is ready for more weight.
progressLoad.conclusionVariation: Holding the top consistently earns the harder variation.
progressLoad.actionVariation: I kept the target at the top of the range.

graduate.text: You outgrew {{from}}, so I moved you up to {{ex}}.
graduate.observation: {{from}} has sat at the top of its range for weeks.
graduate.conclusion: You outgrew it — the harder variation is the next step.

reprice.text: Last week {{ex}} came in under its prescription, so I set it to {{load}} kg and kept your sets unchanged.
reprice.textBw: Last week {{ex}} came in under its prescription, so I matched it to your demonstrated capability and kept your sets unchanged.
reprice.observation: Last week {{ex}} came in under its prescription.
reprice.conclusion: That shows me the right weight for now.
reprice.action: I set it to {{load}} kg and kept your sets unchanged.
reprice.actionBw: I matched it to your demonstrated capability and kept your sets unchanged.

leverVol.text: {{ex}} held steady, so I added a set for more stimulus.
leverVol.conclusion: More sets give it more stimulus.

leverLoad.text: {{ex}} stalled with full volume, so I added {{delta}} kg to break it.
leverLoad.textStep: {{ex}} stalled with full volume, so I stepped the load up to break it.
leverLoad.observation: {{ex}} stalled with its full volume in place.
leverLoad.conclusion: A small load increase breaks the stall.

leverRange.text: {{ex}} stalled with full volume, so I changed the range to {{lo}} to {{hi}} and kept the lift.
leverRange.observation: {{ex}} stalled with its full volume in place.
leverRange.conclusion: A new rep range keeps the same lift moving.
leverRange.action: I set the range to {{lo}} to {{hi}}.

patientHold.text: {{ex}} is steady, so I hold it and re-test before pushing.
patientHold.conclusion: I hold and re-test before pushing.
patientHold.action: I hold this week and probe a small increase soon.

swap.text: That slot missed the mark for a few weeks while your other lifts held, so I swapped it to {{ex}}.
swap.observation: That slot has missed the mark for a few weeks while your other lifts held.
swap.conclusion: The exercise is the thing to change.

deload.text: I pulled the weight and volume back so you can keep training safely.
deload.observation: You flagged something to train around.
deload.conclusion: I pull the weight and volume back so you can train safely.
deload.action: I eased it to {{load}} kg and {{sets}} sets.
deload.actionBw: I eased it to bodyweight and {{sets}} sets.

absence.text: After more than a week away, I eased the load about ten percent and we rebuild.
absence.observation: More than a week passed without training.
absence.conclusion: I ease back in to rebuild safely.
absence.action: I eased about ten percent to {{load}} kg.

adherenceHold.text: I held everything and trimmed the volume to make this week finishable.
adherenceHold.observation: Last week did not fully happen.
adherenceHold.conclusion: I hold everything and trim volume so this week is finishable.
